resources.string: This phone\'s health at a glance: battery, storage, memory, network.
One metric, big: battery, storage, memory or network.
device health, on your home screen

AegisForge reads this phone's own health -- battery, storage, memory, network and screen-lock state -- and shows it in a home-screen widget, in the Sentinel House look.

Nothing leaves the device: there is no account, no network call, no tracking. The widget refreshes itself periodically and when you tap it.

To add it: long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, find AegisForge, and drop the size you want (small, medium or large). You pick a style -- and, for a metric widget, which metric -- when you place it.
